args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

round_money previously used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring promising
banker's rounding per FIN-212. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to
the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66), fixing the failing test in
tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` by implementing banker's rounding in `src/money.py` as required by FIN-212.

## Problem

`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring (and FIN-212) specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This made `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` fail on the nightly build:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` with `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Change

- Switched the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (✅).

/cc @code-owner — requesting your approval so this fix ships in today's release.
